notes: PDF has 199 pages (July 24, 2026 card; Aug 19 changelog). Claude Mythos 5 shares a seed API alias with Claude Fable 5 but the card reports distinct scores, so Mythos 5 is left as rawModelName. Many figure-only results (political bias, MASK honesty rate bars, SHADE/LinuxArena exact bars, multilingual GMMLU/MILU/INCLUDE, some cyber figures) lack readable numbers in pdftotext and were skipped or approximated only when text stated a number (SHADE ~4–5% stored as 4.5). Capability section capped: summary Table 8.1.A plus selected text results; not every effort-scaling figure. SecureBio/Deloitte/Signature Science and CAIS appear as evaluation partners more than independent external testers. Reasoning-modes quote spans a page break around p52–53.
